column5: Sets the stance pardosa speaks from -- mechanism stated neutrally, no compliance claim -- the frame every later refusal follows from
Fixes the scope boundary of the erasure guarantee: the pardosa layer only, the old artefact out of scope
Decides what the public lifecycle types expose across the serialization boundary: vocabulary, not DTOs
Lays down the standing rule that the spec states the rule not the technique, binding every later primitive choice
Spans scope and stance; higher-leverage reading taken -- the citable refusal posture that guarantees below the storage layer are never made
States SWMR as the universal invariant binding every adapter and every later exclusion decision
States the fresh-identity invariant at every generation boundary, from which later rulings are derived
Defines the length of the coordinated freeze window relative to the source's append rate
Puts the migration manager inside the frozen 1.0 surface, fixing what may no longer change without a major
Makes the writer fence unconditional -- a constraint with no configuration escape, binding all adopters
Decides where the epoch is recorded and therefore who can read it, rather than an external coordinator or the operator
Normative behavioural rule binding the caller: the CAS loser must stop rather than retry
Decides artefact structure -- the metastream is an existing store type, not a new parallel artefact
States the hard two-generation invariant, explicitly rejecting a configurable limit
A naming rule: an identical stem pairs .pgno with .meta, giving a mechanically checkable predicate
States the terminating invariant of the ownership model: a .meta has no .meta
Spans field list and verdict discipline; higher taken -- the never-fold-Indeterminate stance is the frame RULED 29/44/51/57 all derive from
Selects the concrete creation mechanism and its division of labour in the artefact creation flow
Refuses a shape unconditionally (orphan .pgno) and fixes creation order as normative, rejecting auto-repair in all forms
Supplies the test that settles what is in scope, keeping snapshotting a permanent non-goal
Assigns a standing obligation to every adapter's write path, where the invariant has to bind
Adds a capability to the public surface, deciding what every adapter's API must expose
Decides which artefact carries which record and therefore what a generation-N reader can discover
Decides what a read-only open reports to its caller: unowned, generation unknown, rather than a refusal
Selects the concrete ongoing fence mechanism sitting on the .pgno write path
Draws the scope boundary between this map and the transfer map by kind of question
Refuses a shape: no writer opens where the fence is unavailable, so no fence is off by default
Sets the granularity, and therefore the strength, of the negative feedback loop that rejects stale writes
Refusal rule plus the two-causes-two-names discipline binding the vocabulary that follows
Keeps unpersistable states on the public surface and obliges the docs to state the in-flight-only fact
Fixes the surviving policy vocabulary by retiring one enum outright
Freezes both enums as exhaustive, so any later variant costs a major -- the evolvability commitment is the substance
Withholds FiberAction from the public surface
Defines what the output artefact discloses: a dense chain from which a purge is undetectable
Decides who chooses and where the choice is recorded, so audit and no-residue hold at once
Scope boundary for 1.0, keeping deferral visibly distinct from permanent non-goal
Normative clause binding pardosa's own behaviour: it never initiates a migration
Narrows the closure's type contract so the caller cannot touch the envelope pardosa owns
Extends a standing constructor rule to a further class, one rule not two
Refuses a shape by name: a generation-N cursor against N+1 is rejected, never reinterpreted
Splits what is frozen from what stays free to change: format locked, store abstraction internal and unfrozen
Freezes the record-kind set and rejects unknown kinds, fixing what may be added without a major
Rules the behaviour for a named state: an empty .meta is unowned and claimable by the ordinary path
States the governing distinction -- missing safety refuses, missing evidence yields Indeterminate -- settling every future platform gap
Confines self-claim to the recursion base so there is exactly one way to own a store
Executes the kind test to put wire shape out of scope for this map
Fixes the artefact topology: one metastream per data-store artefact, chained by pointer
Fixes the on-disk structure: one container format, its placement, and stem matching
Scope boundary: no pair tooling at 1.0, the requirement stated rather than promised
Decides what pardosa reports to a reader and what it refuses to do with it -- reporting, never redirecting
Applies the never-fold discipline as a rule: two directions, two names, and the read proceeds
Fixes what the pointer's presence discloses -- a complete target, unconditionally -- timing being the mechanism
States the 1.0 posture as a rule: no takeover without proof, guessing being forbidden
Shapes the surface a caller meets: three types for three questions, success never dressed as failure
Keeps the top-level enum non_exhaustive, reserving headroom to add failure modes without a major
Decides what the error withholds: adapter detail yes, adapter type never, by any route
Standing rule that an indeterminate outcome is never folded, because the remedy differs
Fixes concrete variant membership and each name's reserved meaning on the create path
Adds a distinct variant to the vocabulary for the fenced-mid-write condition
Fixes one shared name for the orphan refusal condition across both adapters
Chooses documentation structure over an accessor, deciding how remedy information reaches the caller
One type for one question, so a caller need not know what to ask before knowing what they hold
Withholds any diagnostic channel beyond the payload, bounding what the frozen surface discloses
